main_text.l: χαίαν [?] D. Stephanum Gaussenum in Acad. Sal-
in cap. LIII. Esai. Latinè reddidi D.
ter orbi literario probavit in nova
sua Chronologia & harmonia , item in obser-
apud Hubinum in vico St. Martini edi-
dit. Et oftendet porro in illa quaestio-
ne , An Christus die mortem eius praecedente
negativa , nec ut credo absque magno

page.notes: The Greek phrase in the first line is only partly legible; the reading φίλην εἰς παιδίᾳ χαίαν is doubtful. The page is stained, and the faint marks at the edges are not printed text. The number 455 may be misread.
